description: DREAM3D models radiation-belt evolution through radial, pitch-angle and momentum diffusion. Wave information derived from CRRES observations drives the documented three-dimensional diffusion calculations. The resource is documented by NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center (metadata publisher; developer not specified). The documented physical domain is Magnetosphere / Inner Magnetosphere / RadiationBelt; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. Only the web documentation and method were verified. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The input points to an older WVU version; this review does not establish present executable distribution or maintenance. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.
